# BotNira

> BotNira is a multi-tenant AI receptionist & sales-assistant platform that answers business calls, WhatsApp messages, web chats, SMS and emails 24/7. It books appointments, qualifies leads, captures payments and runs outbound sales campaigns — in 90+ languages.

BotNira is built for service businesses, clinics, salons, lawyers, immigration consultants, restaurants, hotels, agencies, real-estate teams, and B2B sales teams. The product unifies five customer channels (Voice / WhatsApp / Web chat / SMS / Email) into one inbox and one AI brain that learns the vendor's business from a short description and FAQs.

Pricing starts at USD $49/month (Starter), $149/month (Growth — includes AI Sales Assistant) and $399/month (Pro — includes AI Sales Assistant). All plans include all five channels, with hard-stop usage limits so vendors never face surprise bills.

- [Contact](https://botnira.com/#contact): Inquiry form + WhatsApp + email for sales and partnerships.
- [Privacy policy](https://botnira.com/privacy): How vendor + customer data is handled.
- [Terms of service](https://botnira.com/terms): Subscription, fair-use and acceptable-use terms.

## Search-intent landing pages

- [AI Sales Agent](https://botnira.com/ai-sales-agent): How BotNira replaces SDR/BDR roles — outbound calls, inbound chat, lead qualification, demo booking.
- [AI Appointment Booking Software](https://botnira.com/ai-appointment-booking-software): Automated multi-channel appointment booking with calendar sync, reminders and waitlist refills.
- [AI Chatbot for Immigration Consultants](https://botnira.com/ai-chatbot-for-immigration-consultants): Multilingual lead qualification + paid-consult booking for RCICs and immigration law firms.
- [Replace Sales Team with AI](https://botnira.com/replace-sales-team-with-ai): Cost comparison and migration playbook for replacing human SDRs with BotNira.
- [WhatsApp AI Assistant](https://botnira.com/whatsapp-ai-assistant): Official WhatsApp Business Cloud API integration, multilingual replies, payments, embedded signup.
- [24/7 AI Receptionist](https://botnira.com/24-7-ai-receptionist): Always-on phone/WhatsApp/email reception for SMBs, clinics, salons and service businesses.
